jobs.title: Music Community Ambassador | First Chair Programme
jobs.description: Help shape the future of music teaching in London Are you part of London’s music community and passionate about teaching? Join First Chair , Matchspace Music’s founding ambassador programme, and help bring Europe’s leading platform for music educators to musicians across London. We’re selecting six musicians to help launch Matchspace Music in the UK. You’ll connect with fellow musicians across the city, share what you’re hearing on the ground, and help us understand what independent music teachers need to build and grow their teaching practice. You won’t be handed a script to promote. You’ll help shape how we arrive in London, from the very first week. About Matchspace Music Matchspace Music is Europe’s leading platform for music educators. We help independent music teachers build a professional online presence, get discovered by students, manage their lesson offers and get paid, all in one place. Founded in Switzerland in 2020, we are home to more than 2,000 qualified teachers across over 100 instruments, with more than 2,100 international teachers registered ahead of our launch. We’re now bringing this to the UK, starting with London. What you’ll do As a First Chair ambassador, you’ll: Introduce Matchspace Music to musicians in your peer networks. Start conversations about teaching and the challenges of building an independent teaching practice. Share feedback from your community with the Matchspace Music team. Contribute your own perspective to help shape our UK launch. Work with the team to develop an approach that feels relevant and authentic to London’s music community. This is a six-month freelance engagement, working remotely for four hours per week , starting immediately. Hours can be planned around your studies or other commitments. What you’ll bring We’d like to hear from musicians who: Are actively connected to London’s music community. Care about music teaching and want to help improve how it works. So können wir in Zukunft einen noch grösseren und wichtigeren Beitrag zur Fitness und Gesundheit der Schweizer Bevölkerung leisten. Kein Problem – alternativ zur Festanstellung bieten wir dir auch eine freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit zu einem attraktiven höheren Stundenlohn an. Sprich uns gerne direkt darauf an. Für weitere Informationen hierzu wenden dich bitte direkt an die Studioleitung. jobs.title: Freelancer - Group Fitness Instructor (m/w/d)
jobs.description: En tant que membre du groupe international PureGym , qui compte plus de 2 millions de membres, nous faisons partie des trois plus grandes chaînes de fitness en Europe. Nous sommes ainsi idéalement positionnés pour poursuivre et réaliser nos objectifs ambitieux. À l’avenir, nous pourrons ainsi contribuer encore davantage à la forme physique et à la santé de la population suisse. Pour renforcer notre équipe Group Fitness motivée, nous recherchons dès maintenant une personne passionnée par le sport pour le poste de Group Fitness Instructor (h/f/d) en freelance pour notre club de Geneve Cornavin , notamment pour les cours suivants : LesMills BODYPUMP, M.A.X., RIDE, TONE, GRIT, ZUMBA, H.I.I.T., PILATES, BODYATTACK, BODYCOMBAT, YOGAFLOW/POWERYOGA, STEP. Tes missions : Tu animes les cours de Group Fitness et transmets tes connaissances avec beaucoup d’enthousiasme. Tu es présent(e) pour nos membres et les accompagnes avant, pendant et après tes cours. Tu prépares tes cours, maintiens une bonne dynamique de groupe et motives les participant(e)s tout au long de la séance. Tu veilles au respect des règles de propreté et d’hygiène dans la salle de cours. Tu connais nos offres ainsi que notre philosophie et sais les transmettre à nos membres. Idéalement, tu organises toi-même tes remplacements et es également disposé(e) à remplacer d’autres instructeurs si nécessaire. Ce que tu apportes : Tu travailles déjà en tant que freelance dans le domaine du Group Fitness et peux justifier de ton statut d’indépendant(e). Tu disposes déjà d’une solide expérience en tant que Group Fitness Instructor pour les types de cours mentionnés et peux présenter des diplômes de Group Fitness ou des diplômes reconnus dans les domaines du yoga et du Pilates. Tu as le talent de motiver les autres et de les aider à progresser à chaque entraînement. Tu enthousiasmes nos membres grâce à la diversité de tes entraînements et sais accompagner aussi bien les débutant(e)s que les participant(e)s avancé(e)s vers

jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer - AI Tutor
jobs.description: About DataCamp DataCamp's mission is to empower everyone with the data and AI skills essential for 21st-century success. By providing practical, engaging learning experiences, DataCamp equips learners and organizations of all sizes to harness the power of data and AI. As a trusted partner to over 17 million learners and 6,000+ companies , including 80% of the Fortune 1000, DataCamp is leading the charge in addressing the critical data and AI skills shortage. About the role Research has consistently shown that one-on-one tutoring dramatically outperforms traditional classroom instruction—a finding known as Bloom's 2 Sigma Problem. Despite decades of awareness, no solution has successfully delivered personalized tutoring at scale. Until now. We are building an AI tutoring system designed to emulate and eventually surpass the best human tutors. You will work on the core AI system that delivers real-time, adaptive learning experiences to learners. If you're excited about building the future of human learning, this role is for you. This role can be done remotely from anyone of the following; United States, United Kingdom, Belgium, Portugal OR UAE About you At DataCamp, we seek individuals who embody our core values of data-driven decision-making, action, transparency, ownership, and customer focus. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-performing environment and are driven by a passion for making a meaningful impact. You're adaptable, embracing change and ambiguity with enthusiasm. Your initiative and entrepreneurial spirit push you beyond just meeting targets—you aim to understand the "why" behind our goals and take ownership to drive the business forward. You're a collaborative team player who values transparency and always seeks to improve and innovate. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply!
